title: Peaky Blinders — Thomas Shelby's ambition

hook.quote: By order of the Peaky Blinders.
hook.context: Shelbylar to'dasi o'z hukmini e'lon qilganda shu iborani ishlatadi — rasmiy farmon ohangida. "by order of" — "... ning buyrug'i bilan" degan rasmiy ibora.

reading: Birmingham, 1919. The First World War has ended, and men have come home with terrible memories. Thomas Shelby is one of them.
Tommy leads the Peaky Blinders, a family gang that controls illegal betting in the city. He is clever, calm and ambitious. He refuses to stay small.
Tommy avoids showing emotion. He prefers to think quietly with a cigarette while everyone else is shouting.
His aunt Polly manages the family business. She keeps reminding Tommy that family comes first, but he often decides to take risks without asking anyone.
When a police inspector, Campbell, arrives from Belfast to clean up the city, Tommy doesn't stop working. Instead, he tries to use the inspector for his own plans.
Tommy dreams of moving the family business into legal companies. He wants to become respectable, but he can't stop fighting old enemies.
The series is about a man who has survived the war but has never really managed to leave it behind.

questions.q: Where does Inspector Campbell come from?

grammar.title: Gerund yoki infinitive: avoid doing / decide to do
explain: Ba'zi fe'llardan keyin **-ing (gerund)**: **avoid, enjoy, keep, finish, mind, suggest, stop** (to'xtatmoq). Tommy **avoids showing** emotion. She **keeps reminding** him.
Ba'zilaridan keyin **to + fe'l (infinitive)**: **decide, refuse, want, hope, plan, manage, agree, promise**. He **decides to take** risks. He **refuses to stay** small.
Predlogdan keyin har doim **-ing**: dream **of moving**, good **at playing**, instead **of waiting**, before **leaving**.
Ma'nosi o'zgaradiganlar: **stop doing** (odatni tashlamoq) / **stop to do** (biror ish qilish uchun to'xtamoq); **remember doing** (qilganini eslamoq) / **remember to do** (qilishni unutmaslik).
